articles.title: Osasuna Goalkeeper Gets Bizarre Red Card After Handling Ball Way Outside the Box

articles.image_caption: A goalkeeper rushing outside the penalty area
articles.nri_angle: The incident went viral among Indian football fans, highlighting the growing global popularity of La Liga and the ongoing debate about sweeper-keeper tactics in modern football.

articles.title: Cricket Australia Opens Door to Hosting IPL Matches in Landmark Exchange With BCCI
articles.excerpt: Following the announcement that the BBL season opener will be played in Chennai, Cricket Australia has initiated discussions with the BCCI about bringing IPL fixtures to Australian venues as early as March 2027.
articles.nri_angle: Australia's estimated 800,000-strong Indian diaspora could see IPL matches played on their doorstep, as Cricket Australia courts the BCCI with a venue exchange.

articles.title: India Finishes Fourth at CWG 2026 With 39 Medals as Boxers Lead Historic Gold Rush

articles.title: Kashmir's Owais Yaqoob Stuns Unbeaten Delyan Georgiev With First-Round TKO in Bulgaria

articles.title: Bumrah Out of Sri Lanka Tests; J&K's Auqib Nabi Gets Maiden India Call-Up
